versions.name: Whitewater
versions.description: Read a river's eddies, ledges and downstream Vs, ferry and peel out in a canoe or kayak, throw and catch a rescue rope, and paddle a planned trip on Class I or Class II water.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
